item.title: github: Control GitHub Actions cache access with cache-mode
item.description:
GitHub Actions now supports cache-mode to control cache access at the workflow or job level. This lets you grant least-privilege cache access instead of broad cache permissions.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise managed permissions for GitHub Copilot agent operations
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Business and Enterprise admins can now centrally manage agent operation permissions. Admins can set operations to be blocked, require human approval, or run without prompting.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Apps can now access enterprise billing data
item.description:
GitHub Apps can now be granted access to enterprise billing data by enterprise owners. The app configuration flow now includes an enterprise billing permission that can be selected when creating or updating an app.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Enterprise managed settings in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now supports enterprise managed settings. Administrators can centrally control plugin governance, MCP server access, OpenTelemetry, and permission modes across the enterprise.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Triage role can bypass issue creation restrictions
item.description:
GitHub changed issue creation restrictions so users with the triage role can now create issues in repositories where issue creation is limited to collaborators only. Previously, only users with write access could create issues under that setting.

  • Source: GitHub
